text: 【国家统计局：7月官方制造业PMI为49.2%】7月份，制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.2%，比上月下降1.1个百分点，景气水平有所回落。从企业规模看，大、中、小型企业PMI分别为49.5%、49.7%和47.4%，比上月下降1.2个、0.8个和0.8个百分点，均低于临界点。从分类指数看，构成制造业PMI的5个分类指数中，生产指数、新订单指数、原材料库存指数、从业人员指数和供应商配送时间指数均低于临界点。
text_en: 【NBS: July official manufacturing PMI at 49.2%】In July, the Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) stood at 49.2%, down 1.1 percentage points from the previous month, indicating a decline in business activity. By enterprise size, PMI for large, medium, and small enterprises was 49.5%, 49.7%, and 47.4%, respectively, down 1.2, 0.8, and 0.8 percentage points from the previous month, all below the threshold. Among the five sub-indices that constitute the manufacturing PMI, the production index, new orders index, raw material inventory index, employment index, and supplier delivery time index all remained below the threshold.
